critical_code_review_comments: PlusMembersTab.jsx line 44 reads localStorage 'cm_admin_jwt' but other admin tabs use 'admin_jwt' (lib/api.js helpers). Same mismatch flagged in iter208 for ComingSoonTab. If admin login stores under 'admin_jwt', the Replenish-now button will 401. Worth a one-line fix to use the shared api helper. NOT a regression from this iter — pre-existing.

seed_admin.py generate-batch runs N sequential calls; a single template's 60-120s LLM latency × 5 = up to 10 min wall clock. The FastAPI worker will be tied up. Acceptable for an on-demand admin button (single user) but if you ever expose this elsewhere, consider a BackgroundTask + status-polling pattern.

CommunityDesignsSeedCard.runBatch hardcodes count=5 (line 271 of SettingsTab.jsx). If you want admins to pick 1/3/5/10 you'll need a picker — UI currently has no count selector despite backend accepting 1-10.
